text.en:
The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
for locally produced cement the 7 per cent sales tax and
for electrical wires, the 17 per sent special excise tax
on foreigr. exchange," 7 per cent sales tax and. 1 per-
cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Baguio, this 9th day of May, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
